en.t: What does it matter if he was abandoned as a child?

units.source_text: 水木说，“我说这些，是想让你心里有个数。

en.t: Mizuki said, “I am telling you this so that you will have some idea of the situation.

units.source_text: 那么，是不是可以让龙助上贵店去帮忙呢？”

en.t: So, would it be possible to have Ryusuke come and help at your shop?”
